title: DIR-074: Executive User Identity & M3 Account Dropdown Pipeline Overhaul
spec: P0 ARCHITECTURAL MANDATES: 1. USER IDENTITY & ROLE ENHANCEMENT (NO RAW PARENTHESES): In src/components/cuba/M3UserMenu.jsx and shells (CubaCandidateShell.jsx, CubaPortalShell.jsx), implement robust identity parsing (parseUserIdentity utility). When a displayName contains parenthetical roles (e.g. 'Bhaskar Beyond (Super Admin)'), cleanly extract the clean name ('Bhaskar Beyond') and the role ('Super Admin'). On the top trigger chip, render the clean name on row 1 and the role on row 2 (text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400). In the dropdown popover, render the clean name, email, and a dedicated executive Cuba badge (not raw text with parentheses) with role-tailored styling (Super Admin, Admin, Recruiter, Org Admin, Candidate). 2. CLEAN UP SOURCE DATA: In scripts/deep-clean-production.cjs line 68, update displayName to 'Bhaskar Beyond' (clean name without parenthetical role) while preserving customClaims.role = 'SUPER_ADMIN'. 3. DROPDOWN PIPELINE AUDIT & DECOUPLING (10/10 EXPERIENCE): In src/components/cuba/accountLinks.js, fix the Candidate settings destination from '/dashboard/settings' to '/dashboard/settings?tab=account' so 'Your profile' (?tab=profile -> Master Profile) and 'Settings' (?tab=account -> Account & Preferences) have distinct, purposeful destinations rather than both landing on Profile. In DashboardSettings.jsx, ensure ?tab=security or ?tab=2fa smoothly scrolls to the 2FA / TOTP Security Hub card. 4. FULL PIPELINE VALIDATION: Verify each dropdown item across Candidate, Admin (/admin/operators or /admin/settings, /admin/security), Recruiter (/employer/settings), and Enterprise (/org/<slug>/settings, /org/<slug>/security). Verify Dark/Light theme toggles and Sign out pipeline. 5. COMMAND PALETTE SEARCH INPUT BOX STYLING (10/10 EXECUTIVE POLISH): In src/components/cuba/CubaCommandPalette.jsx, strip 'cuba-focus-ring' from <input> (which previously drew an isolated purple outline box around only the text string, leaving FiSearch on the left and [Esc] on the right stranded). Make the input completely borderless (border-0 outline-none ring-0 focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus-visible:outline-none). Style the search container row as a seamless, unified, elegant executive search bar (Linear/Spotlight style) without disjointed inner boxes. 6. INVARIANTS: Preserve existing tests/cuba-design-system.test.mjs, tests/copilot-command-surface.test.mjs, tests/dir072-notifications-messages-decoupling.test.mjs, tests/dir073-command-palette-overhaul.test.mjs, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility (role=menu, role=menuitem, roving tabindex), zero regression on 55 frozen CV templates, and sub-4s Vite build.

plan.summary: DIR-074 P0 recon complete, every finding cited to file:line. FINDINGS: (1) M3UserMenu.jsx:88-90 reads user.name/user.email/user.role RAW, so the trigger chip at :155-163 renders the raw name (Bhaskar Beyond (Super Admin) shows WITH parentheses) and the popover at :190-214 renders the same raw name plus a role pill; there is NO identity parser anywhere in the repo. FIX: new pure module src/components/cuba/userIdentity.js exporting parseUserIdentity() and roleBadgeFor(); the chip renders the clean name on row 1 and the role label on row 2 with text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400, and the popover renders a role-tailored executive badge (Super Admin / Admin / Recruiter / Org Admin / Candidate) instead of raw parenthetical text. (2) ROOT CAUSE: scripts/deep-clean-production.cjs:68 writes displayName Bhaskar Beyond (Super Admin); change it to Bhaskar Beyond while keeping customClaims.role SUPER_ADMIN (lines 61-64 untouched). (3) accountLinks.js:86 sends candidate Settings to /dashboard/settings, the SAME pane as profile (?tab=profile), so both menu items land on Profile. FIX: settings -> /dashboard/settings?tab=account. DashboardSettings.jsx:378-396 already maps ?tab=account|security|2fa onto the Account pane but never scrolls, and the 2FA card heading at :5654 (Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP 2FA)) has no id, so FIX: add a stable id to that card and smooth-scroll to it when tab is security or 2fa. (4) Pipeline audit: candidate profile ?tab=profile, settings ?tab=account, security ?tab=security; admin /admin/settings + /admin/security; recruiter /employer/settings; enterprise orgPathFor(settings|security). Every target is a mounted route; the theme toggle and sign-out flow through onToggleTheme and the Firebase onSignOut unchanged. (5) New regression suite tests/dir074-user-identity-menu.test.mjs. ZERO fabricated data: every value still comes from the authenticated session.
